metadata.summary: Jitin attempted to order an Omelet Wrap but it was out of stock, and the agent offered alternative breakfast items.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I want to order omelette wrap.

That will be our Omelet Wrap on the menu, now let me check the availability. I've checked, and I'm sorry, but that item is currently out of stock today. Instead, I can offer you our Original Classic breakfast sandwich, the Egg & Cheese, or the Garden
